name: Workspace Number Indicator
description:
Shows the current workspace number in the top panel, as just the number (2) or current / total (2 / 4). Click it to toggle the Overview.

Options:
- Place the indicator on the left or right of the top bar, before or after the Activities button
- Hide the Activities button workspace pills
- Keyboard shortcuts: Super+1…0 switches to workspace 1–10 and Shift+Super+1…0 moves the focused window there
